clue.text: Make assistant, keeping in control

parts.note: to make something is to do it, as in 'do a drawing'

indicators.note: one piece keeping another holds it inside, so the assistant word wraps round 'in'

parts.note: a mate is a helper, as in a plumber's mate

explanation.surface: An order to promote someone to assistant while still staying in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: To dominate is to have power over and govern, a straightforward synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Increase in manipulated figures heartlessly rejected

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the trimmed word is read backwards
heartlessly says the central letter of the seven-letter word is removed

parts.note: puppets are figures worked by strings or a hand

explanation.surface: Someone reports a rise in statistics that were fiddled and then thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartlessly' takes the central P out of PUPPETS, leaving PUPETS; 'rejected' turns that round. 'figures' looks statistical, but here they are marionettes.
explanation.definitionFit: To step up output is to raise it; as a noun phrase a step-up is a rise.

clue.text: Deliberately drive into animal

definitions.meaning: to ... a vehicle is to crash into it on purpose
a male sheep

explanation.definitionFit: Ramming is a deliberate collision, and a ram is the male of the sheep.

clue.text: Force to accept fantasy

parts.note: to make someone do something is to force them
to believe a story is to accept it as true

explanation.surface: Being made to accept an invented story as if it were real.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-believe is pretending or imagining, which is the realm of fantasy.

clue.text: Light chatter, in long feature

parts.note: a lantern is a portable light
jaw is informal for talk or chatter

explanation.surface: A newspaper's lengthy feature article full of light gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feature' looks like a newspaper article, but it means a part of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A lantern jaw is a long thin jaw, a facial feature that is notably elongated.

clue.text: A French town that may be before your eyes

definitions.meaning: A mining town in northern France

definitions.text: that may be before your eyes
definitions.meaning: a glass for spectacles or a contact ... sits in front of the eye

explanation.definitionFit: Lens names a town in the Pas-de-Calais and also a shaped piece of glass worn over the eye.

clue.text: Tough old bird that keeps the house warm

definitions.meaning: a hen too old for roasting, only fit to be stewed
the domestic water heater for central heating

explanation.definitionFit: A boiler is both an old fowl for the pot and the household heating appliance.

clue.text: Loudspeaker transmitting in short bursts?

definitions.meaning: a small speaker unit producing high notes
someone posting short messages online, a bird-like chirper

explanation.definitionFit: A tweeter is a high-frequency speaker unit and also a person posting brief online messages.

clue.text: Cuts pub measures, according to reports

indicators.note: according to reports signals that the phrase is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: an inn is a pub; sizes are measures, as of drinks served

explanation.surface: Someone trims the measures served at a pub, so the gossip goes.
explanation.definitionFit: To incise is to make a cut into something, so incises is a synonym for cuts as a verb.

clue.text: Available to everyone, one pound advanced for such a bouquet

indicators.note: advanced means moved forward, so one pound letter shifts towards the front

parts.note: something open to all is for all
L, from Latin libra, stands for a pound

explanation.surface: A bouquet offered to all, with a pound paid in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advanced' moves one of the two Ls of FORALL forward to second place, giving FLORAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A floral arrangement is made of flowers, which is what a bouquet is.

clue.text: Make a face, having weapon, squeezing trigger at last

indicators.note: squeezing means holding tightly inside, so the weapon wraps round a letter

parts.note: a gun is a weapon

indicators.note: at last picks out the final letter of the word trigger

explanation.surface: Someone pulls a face while holding a gun, finally squeezing the trigger.
explanation.walkthrough: GURN is a British dialect word for pulling a grotesque face, as in north-country gurning contests.
explanation.definitionFit: To gurn is to pull a distorted grimace, which is making a face.

clue.text: Impossible to dress for business, perhaps, when not fit?

definitions.text: Impossible to dress for business, perhaps
definitions.meaning: not able to be put in a suit
inappropriate or improper

explanation.definitionFit: Unsuitable means inappropriate; read in parts it also says a person cannot be fitted with a suit.

clue.text: How one may get ready, say, when bank is closed

parts.note: a new arrangement of the letters of years day gives ready say

explanation.surface: Advice on preparing for something, perhaps when the bank shuts.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: read NEW as an anagram signal and YEARS DAY as its fodder, and the letters come out as READY SAY. 'bank' means a bank holiday, a British public holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: The first of January is a bank holiday in Britain, a day when banks close.

clue.text: I departed, heading off

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: someone who has departed has gone

explanation.surface: Someone announces they have left, setting off.
explanation.definitionFit: I as a Roman numeral stands for one, the single unit.

clue.text: Hedge was found unsatisfactory

parts.note: lay, past tense of lie, as in 'the town lay to the north' meaning it was located
off means not up to standard, as in 'that's a bit off'

explanation.surface: A garden hedge was judged not good enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hedge' looks like a garden boundary, but it means to hedge a bet: a bookmaker lays off risk by placing bets elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay off a bet is to hedge it, spreading the risk by betting with another bookmaker.

clue.text: City man as investor with opera company

parts.note: an angel is a backer of a theatrical production
ENO is English National Opera, a London company

explanation.surface: A city businessman acting as a backer of an opera company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'City man' suggests a London financier, but the city is Los Angeles.
explanation.definitionFit: An Angeleno is an inhabitant of Los Angeles, a man of that city.

clue.text: Bank holds up inspector dreadfully

indicators.note: holds up in a down clue means the second piece sits beneath and supports the first

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector
to bank on something is to rely on it

explanation.surface: A bank robbery that holds up a police inspector, with dreadful results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' looks like a financial institution, but it is the verb, as in 'bank on'.
explanation.definitionFit: Direly means in a dire way, that is terribly or dreadfully.

clue.text: Reminder from wise guide almost creating an opening for me

indicators.note: creating an opening for means the speaker's word goes first, at the start

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a mentor is a wise adviser

explanation.surface: A keepsake from a trusted adviser that nearly opened a door for the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento is a souvenir kept to remind one of a person or event.

clue.text: So very many in need of anaesthetic?

definitions.meaning: too many to count
lacking numbness, read as ..., more numb lacking

explanation.definitionFit: Numberless means countless; split differently it describes someone less numb who needs a numbing drug.

clue.text: One prankster I ordered to be arrested

indicators.note: ordered means arranged anew, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A practical joker is told he is to be arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone taken prisoner has been seized and held, which is what arrested means.

clue.text: Heel over very fast, when full

definitions.meaning: a ship heels over when it leans to one side
full ... means at top speed

explanation.definitionFit: To tilt is to lean, as a heeling ship does; at full tilt means at maximum speed.

clue.text: Showing up, having been posted earlier?

definitions.meaning: being ... means attending
..., sent beforehand

explanation.definitionFit: Present means in attendance; split it reads as sent ahead of time.

clue.text: Fun at Her Majesty's is unlimited

definitions.meaning: enjoyment or delight
a prisoner held at Her Majesty's ... serves an indefinite term

explanation.definitionFit: Pleasure means enjoyment; detention at Her Majesty's pleasure is a British sentence of no fixed length.

clue.text: Donkey, say, is stubborn and deaf on travels, but full of energy

indicators.note: full of means containing, so the jumbled letters hold another inside
on travels means the letters wander about into a new order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A donkey is obstinate and hard of hearing on journeys, yet lively.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Donkey, say' is a definition by example: the donkey is one instance of a pack animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A beast of burden is any animal used to carry loads, a donkey being a classic example.

clue.text: Herb brings end to acute period in type of disease

indicators.note: in puts the letter and the period inside the disease name

parts.note: Lyme disease is a tick-borne infection

indicators.note: end to picks out the final letter of the word acute

parts.note: a month is a period of time

explanation.surface: A herb ends an acute spell of some kind of illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemon thyme is a lemon-scented variety of the herb thyme.

clue.text: Green Goddess comes round at length: it crosses the square

indicators.note: comes round means the goddess's name encircles the other piece

parts.note: Diana is the Roman goddess of hunting
green means go, as on traffic lights

explanation.surface: The Green Goddess, a TV fitness presenter, comes round eventually across a town square.
explanation.walkthrough: The Green Goddess was the nickname of Diana Moran, a British TV fitness presenter of the 1980s, which tempts one to take the whole phrase as DIANA.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagonal line runs corner to corner, crossing a square.

clue.text: In garage, one puts this seed

definitions.meaning: the phrase ...: in a garage one puts the ...
an aromatic seed used in baking

explanation.walkthrough: The first part is a cryptic hint at the phrase CAR AWAY, what one does with a car in a garage.
explanation.definitionFit: Caraway is a plant whose aromatic seeds flavour bread and cakes.

clue.text: Saint came up to welcome doctor

indicators.note: to welcome means to take in, so the verb holds the doctor inside

parts.note: arose means came up or got up
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A saint appeared to greet a physician.
explanation.definitionFit: St Ambrose was a fourth-century bishop of Milan, a saint of the Church.

clue.text: Right to forbid housing opposing players in part of Italy

indicators.note: housing means holding inside, so the veto word contains the players

parts.note: a veto is the right to forbid something
North and East are opponents at the bridge table

explanation.surface: A right to ban the housing of rival teams in an Italian region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Veneto is a region of north-east Italy around Venice.

clue.text: One's bound to take a little refreshment on the way up

indicators.note: on the way up in a down clue means the letters read from bottom to top
a little means only a small part of the word is used

explanation.surface: Someone tied to a journey stops for a small drink while climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little' takes FRES from inside 'refreshment'; 'on the way up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A serf was a medieval labourer bound to the land of a lord.
